verses.text: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me:
“The LORD of Armies says: ‘I am fiercely committed to Zion; my passion for her burns with great anger.’”
“The LORD says: ‘I have returned to Zion and will live in Jerusalem. Jerusalem will be called the Faithful City, and the mountain of the LORD of Armies will be called the Holy Mountain.’”
“The LORD of Armies says: ‘Old men and women will again sit in Jerusalem’s streets, each with a walking stick because of their age.
The city’s streets will be full of boys and girls playing there.’”
“The LORD of Armies says: ‘If this seems impossible to the survivors of this people in those days, should it seem impossible to me?’ says the LORD of Armies.
The LORD of Armies says: ‘Look, I will rescue my people from the lands in the east and west.
I will bring them back to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful and just.’”
“The LORD of Armies says: ‘Be strong, all of you who hear these words today from the prophets—the same words spoken when the foundation of the LORD of Armies’ temple was laid, so it could be rebuilt.
Before those days, neither people nor animals earned anything, and no one could travel safely because of enemies. I turned everyone against their neighbor.
But now I won’t treat the survivors of this people as I did before,’ says the LORD of Armies.
‘There will be peaceful planting, and the vine will bear fruit; the ground will produce crops, and the sky will send dew. I will give all these things to the survivors of this people.
House of Judah and house of Israel, just as you became a curse among the nations, I will save you so you can become a blessing. Don’t be afraid; be strong!’”
“The LORD of Armies says: ‘When your ancestors made me angry, I planned to bring disaster on you and did not change my mind,’ says the LORD of Armies.
‘But now I have decided to do good to Jerusalem and the house of Judah. Don’t be afraid.
Here is what you must do: each of you speak the truth to your neighbor, and make fair, peaceful judgments in your courts.
Don’t plot evil against your neighbor, and don’t love false oaths. I hate all these things,’ says the LORD.”
The word of the LORD of Armies came to me:
“The LORD of Armies says: ‘The fasts in the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months will become joyful celebrations for Judah. So love truth and peace.’”
“The LORD of Armies says: ‘Many peoples and residents of many cities will still come.
People from one city will go to another, saying, “Let’s go quickly to seek the LORD’s favor and seek the LORD of Armies. I’m going too.”’
Many peoples and powerful nations will come to Jerusalem to seek the LORD of Armies and ask for his favor.”
“The LORD of Armies says: ‘In those days, ten men from every language and nation will grab the robe of a Jew and say, “Let us go with you, because we’ve heard that God is with you.”’”
